## History

Minnie May fell severely ill with croup while her parents were away from home. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated her using her past experience with children, saving Minnie May's life. This rescue prompted her mother, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to resume their best friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

Minnie May's life was saved by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when she suffered a severe case of croup while her parents were away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drew on her past experience caring for children to treat Minnie May, an act of heroism that ultimately led Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to resume their friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), +1 more_

- Saved by  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--minnie-may.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) is Minnie May's sister. When Minnie May became dangerously ill with croup in her parents' absence, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sought emergency help from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to save her.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), +1 more_

- Sibling of  _(ended v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>
